Only row 4 happened to already agree (Skill=Skill). Rows 0,3,5 (Varus rows) still carry Tristana-favoured why text that directly contradicts the side they're about to be set to.
audit.why: win[] already holds the target values (confirmed independently by packet.levelChart) and the content whys[]/spikes[] explain WHY Varus wins levels 1, 4-5, and first item (his range/poke/blight) and why Tristana wins 2, 3, and 2+ items (jump-E punish, mobility dives his immobile frame). edits.before: Contest level 1 autos — your early range is real and the all-in threat starts at 2; set the tone.
edits.after: Varus out-ranges you with charged Q and blight poke — he wins the level 1 poke war outright.

edits.before: Trade around the bomb: four stacks detonate — back off at three or commit at four; never linger between.
edits.after: His poke, E zoning, and superior range out-trade you again through this whole stage — respect the distance.

edits.before: Buster Shot peels or executes — the knockback flips dives both directions.
edits.after: His R root vs your dodge decides it — land it and he wins, whiff and you punish.

edits.before: First item spike: the jump-bomb-R string deletes squishies and the resets chain through fights.
edits.after: His first-item blight stacks and poke keep you at range — farm safe, don't force the engage.

edits.before: E the bomb, stack two autos, and step back at three — the threat does the zoning and the fourth stack stays loaded.

edits.before: Jumping in with the bomb unstacked and R down — Tristana without the string is a yordle tourist at a gunfight.

edits.before: - Varus Chain of Corruption: matchup-defining — The spreading root starts dives — stand apart from allies when it flies. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rocket Jump (reset) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Varus's Chain of Corruption cools 100s down to 60s at max rank — the spreading root starts dives; stand apart from allies when it flies. - Your W Rocket Jump cools 22s-14s; its one job is the moment it all goes wrong. - Your 100s R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
